dedupe_keys.name: composition project bin fill level sensor readings from industrial scrap bins in greece 2018 2019

description: These files contain raw readings from sensors that measure how full waste bins are, recorded every few minutes during a smart waste management trial in Greece. The producer is Nikolaos Alexopoulos of the Centre for Research and Technology Hellas, for the European COMPOSITION project, with data shared by the pilot partners KLEEMANN Hellas, a manufacturer, and ELDIA, a waste management company. Coverage is indoor scrap bins from June to August 2019 and an outdoor open-top container from September to November 2018. Each line gives the sensor identifier, fill percentage, battery level and time, with error messages for the indoor bins and the measured distance to the waste surface for the outdoor container. The two text files and a readme are available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: industrial scrap, not household waste, a few bins over one to two months, and unprocessed values that include noise from blocked sensors and people levelling the contents. Simulation uses: testing fill forecasting and dynamic collection scheduling, and generating realistic sensor feeds for waste logistics digital twins. Related records: the Lahore IoT collection pilot (case_study-lahore-iot-waste-collection-pilot) reports a household waste sensor deployment.
